title: Quadratic form as a sum of paired products
statement: Let $r,k$ be natural numbers with $r\le1$. On the binary cube of dimension $r+2k$, the quadratic function $Q(x)=\sum_{i<j}x_i x_j$ can be written as an affine function plus $\sum_{j=1}^k L_j(x)R_j(x)$, where the $2k$ linear forms $L_1,R_1,\ldots,L_k,R_k$ are linearly independent over $\mathbb F_2$.
